headline: Gloucester Public Schools to discuss policy on interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement (Protect Act).
summary: The subcommittee will discuss File ACL, a policy about interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement under the Protect Act.
items: Discuss File ACL - Interacting With Law Enforcement Officers Engaged In Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act)
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930
